prompts.name: informe-sin-drama
prompts.prompt: Use case ads-marketing. Create ONE complete premium Spanish-language EduLab social media advertisement, portrait 4:5, in the SAME visual campaign as reference image 1. Image 1 is a style/layout reference only, not an edit target: create a FRESH sharp natural DSLR photograph and avoid inherited image artifacts. Image 2 is the exact turquoise brain brand mark; small at top beside wordmark EduLab with Edu white and Lab turquoise. Generous navy top space, enormous bold white/turquoise headline, minimal informative copy, warm amber practical light contrasted with soft blue ambient light. Very realistic young adult Latin American university students: clean youthful skin, subtle normal pores, natural smooth tonal gradients, realistic hands and fingers. No engraved/crosshatched textures, no plastic skin, no heavy grain, no illustration. Believable modest university lifestyle, relaxed ironic humour and lived-in texture, no corporate stock posing. Keep photo strong, no sci-fi lasers or glowing brains. Consistent lower-left turquoise rounded CTA with exact text 'Crea, revisa y descarga', below it large bold white exact URL 'edulab.wiki'. Reserve a large EMPTY dark navy space bottom-right about 25 percent of image width square, for the user to add QR later; no QR, no border, no label, no placeholder graphic. Clear type, correct Spanish accents, comfortable margins. No extra copy, no pricing, no free or no-registration claim, no grade guarantee, no claim of university endorsement. Do not replicate the reference's student's portrait; create the requested distinct new scene. Scene: realistic young Latina university student with medium brown skin and long wavy dark hair, seated in a warm cozy bedroom study desk at evening, laptop on desk with a neatly formatted white academic cover titled 'BIOLOGÍA CELULAR', two notebooks and ordinary mug, one hand lightly at her temple, small amused relieved smile, actual candid editorial photograph. Hands visible and anatomically correct. Exact huge headline in two lines: 'Tu informe.' / 'Sin el drama.' Put second line turquoise. Exact subhead: 'Crea tu informe con IA y dale tu toque.' One compact elegant outlined navy benefit strip beneath with exact copy 'Portada automática · Bibliografía en formato APA'. Keep footer and empty QR area as specified. Focus on real student relief and legibility.
